title: Function-On-Function Regression Through Separable Neural Operators
abstract: arXiv:2608.19070v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper investigates the estimation of the regression operator in function-on-function regression models. While traditional research has predominantly focused on linear models or their immediate nonlinear extensions, we propose a neural operator approach to accommodate general regression operators under mild smoothness assumptions. Operator learning has emerged as an active area of machine learning, particularly for solving physical models governed by partial differential equations. Using this paradigm, our methodology introduces the separable neural operator, a neural-operator architecture that represents the regression operator through input-dependent coefficient functions and output-dependent basis functions. Beyond adapting this architecture to the regression operator estimation problem, we establish the consistency of the estimator under relatively mild smoothness and sampling conditions, allowing functional data to be observed

translated_title: 通过可分离神经算子的函数对函数回归
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19070v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：本文研究了函数对函数回归模型中回归算子的估计问题。虽然传统研究主要集中于线性模型或其直接的非线性扩展，但我们提出了一种神经算子方法，以在温和的光滑性假设下适应一般回归算子。算子学习已成为机器学习中一个活跃领域，特别是在求解由偏微分方程控制的物理模型方面。利用这一范式，我们的方法引入了可分离神经算子，这是一种神经算子架构，通过输入依赖的系数函数和输出依赖的基函数来表示回归算子。除了将此架构适应于回归算子估计问题外，我们还在相对温和的光滑性和采样条件下建立了估计量的一致性，允许功能数据被观测到。
tldr: 本文提出了一种可分离神经算子方法，用于在温和假设下估计函数对函数回归中的一般回归算子，并建立了估计量的一致性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a separable neural operator method to estimate general regression operators in function-on-function regression under mild assumptions, establishing estimator consistency.
